| English                              | Français                           | note                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| a stranger, an outsider, a foreigner | {{un étranger}}, {{une étrangère}} | `à l'étranger` = abroad                                                      |

| It doesn't mean anything.            | {{Ça ne veut rien dire.}}          |                                                                              |
| a seniors' residence (Québec)        | {{une résidence pour aînés}}       | the novel's dated word: `un asile`; France: `une maison de retraite`         |
| a funeral                            | {{un enterrement}}                 | formal: `les funérailles`, `les obsèques` (f.)                               |
| to bury                              | {{enterrer}}                       |                                                                              |
| a wake, a vigil over the dead        | {{une veillée funèbre}}            |                                                                              |
| a coffin                             | {{un cercueil}}                    |                                                                              |
| a hearse                             | {{un corbillard}}                  |                                                                              |
| blinding                             | {{aveuglant}}, {{aveuglante}}      |                                                                              |
| to dazzle                            | {{éblouir}}                        | `l'éblouissement` (m.) = the glare                                           |
| sweat                                | {{la sueur}}                       |                                                                              |
| a blade                              | {{une lame}}                       |                                                                              |
| a gunshot                            | {{un coup de feu}}                 |                                                                              |
| to shoot (a gun)                     | {{tirer}}                          |                                                                              |
| a trial                              | {{un procès}}                      |                                                                              |
| the examining magistrate             | {{le juge d'instruction}}          |                                                                              |
| the prosecutor                       | {{le procureur}}                   |                                                                              |
| a lawyer                             | {{un avocat}}, {{une avocate}}     | also an avocado                                                              |
| the accused                          | {{l'accusé}}, {{l'accusée}}        |                                                                              |
| a witness                            | {{un témoin}}                      | `témoigner` = to testify                                                     |
| the death penalty                    | {{la peine de mort}}               |                                                                              |
| to be sentenced to death             | {{être condamné à mort}}           |                                                                              |
| a chaplain                           | {{un aumônier}}                    |                                                                              |
| to pray                              | {{prier}}                          |                                                                              |
| remorse                              | {{le remords}}                     | always ends in `s`                                                           |
| guilty                               | {{coupable}}                       | `la culpabilité` = guilt                                                     |
| the absurd                           | {{l'absurde}} (m.)                 | Camus' word for the gap between our need for meaning and the world's silence |
| a bathrobe                           | {{un peignoir}}                    |                                                                              |

## le vocabulaire abstrait

the nouns of newspapers, reports and the DALF. `une issue` is an outcome or an exit, never a problem.

| English                           | Français                        | note                                                              |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| a stake, what's at stake          | {{un enjeu}}                    | `les enjeux climatiques`                                          |
| the merits, the soundness         | {{le bien-fondé}}               | `le bien-fondé d'une décision`                                    |
| an approach, a process            | {{une démarche}}                | also the way someone walks                                        |
| perspective, distance             | {{le recul}}                    | `prendre du recul` = to step back                                 |
| a pitfall                         | {{un écueil}}                   | literally a reef                                                  |
| a gap, a shortcoming              | {{une lacune}}                  |                                                                   |
| permanence, durability            | {{la pérennité}}                |                                                                   |
| a rise, a boom                    | {{l'essor}} (m.)                | `en plein essor` = booming                                        |
| a craze                           | {{un engouement}}               |                                                                   |
| a divide, a split                 | {{un clivage}}                  |                                                                   |
| a finding, an observation         | {{un constat}}                  |                                                                   |
| an assessment, a review           | {{un bilan}}                    | `faire le bilan`                                                  |
| an awakening, a realization       | {{une prise de conscience}}     |                                                                   |
| a lever                           | {{un levier}}                   |                                                                   |
| an obstacle, a brake              | {{un frein}}                    |                                                                   |
| a constraint                      | {{une contrainte}}              |                                                                   |
| an asset, a trump card            | {{un atout}}                    |                                                                   |
| a challenge                       | {{un défi}}                     | `relever un défi` = to take up a challenge                        |
| a trend                           | {{une tendance}}                |                                                                   |
| a drift, an abuse                 | {{une dérive}}                  |                                                                   |
| growth                            | {{la croissance}}               |                                                                   |
| purchasing power                  | {{le pouvoir d'achat}}          |                                                                   |
| globalization                     | {{la mondialisation}}           |                                                                   |
| global warming                    | {{le réchauffement climatique}} |                                                                   |
| sustainable development           | {{le développement durable}}    |                                                                   |
| a received idea, a cliché         | {{une idée reçue}}              |                                                                   |
| a prejudice                       | {{un préjugé}}                  |                                                                   |
| a gain that lasts, an achievement | {{un acquis}}                   | `les acquis sociaux`                                              |
| the outcome                       | {{l'issue}} (f.)                | also an exit; an issue (a problem): `une question`, `un problème` |

## l'argumentation

the phrases of the C1 essay. the DALF C1 writing test has two parts, a synthesis of documents and an argued essay. French schools train the `plan dialectique`: thesis, antithesis, synthesis.

| English                                | Français                          | note                                                |
| -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| It is worth noting that                | {{Il convient de noter que}}      |                                                     |
| One has to admit that                  | {{Force est de constater que}}    |                                                     |
| in other words                         | {{en d'autres termes}}            |                                                     |
| The fact remains that                  | {{Il n'en demeure pas moins que}} |                                                     |
| insofar as                             | {{dans la mesure où}}             |                                                     |
| following the example of               | {{à l'instar de}}                 |                                                     |
| at the expense of                      | {{au détriment de}}               |                                                     |
| as for                                 | {{quant à}}                       | `quant à moi`                                       |
| regarding                              | {{en ce qui concerne}}            |                                                     |
| far from it                            | {{loin de là}}                    |                                                     |
| admittedly… but                        | {{certes… mais}}                  |                                                     |
| it goes without saying that            | {{il va de soi que}}              |                                                     |
| One may wonder whether                 | {{On peut se demander si}}        |                                                     |
| on the one hand… on the other hand     | {{d'une part… d'autre part}}      |                                                     |
| ultimately                             | {{en définitive}}                 |                                                     |
| all things considered                  | {{tout compte fait}}              | also `somme toute`                                  |
| given that                             | {{étant donné que}}               |                                                     |
| assuming that                          | {{à supposer que}}                | + subjonctif                                        |
| whereas (in contrast)                  | {{alors que}}                     |                                                     |
| to sum up                              | {{en somme}}                      |                                                     |
| to support (an argument with evidence) | {{étayer}}                        | `étayer une thèse par des exemples`                 |
| to qualify, to add nuance to           | {{nuancer}}                       |                                                     |
| to refute                              | {{réfuter}}                       |                                                     |
| to highlight                           | {{mettre en lumière}}             | also `mettre en évidence`, `souligner`              |
| to call into question                  | {{remettre en question}}          |                                                     |
| to take into account                   | {{prendre en compte}}             | also `tenir compte de`                              |
| to stem from                           | {{découler de}}                   |                                                     |
| to lead to, to bring about             | {{entrainer}}                     | traditional spelling: `entraîner`; also `aboutir à` |
| to tackle (a topic)                    | {{aborder}}                       |                                                     |
| the central question (of an essay)     | {{la problématique}}              | not a problem                                       |
| a thesis-antithesis-synthesis plan     | {{un plan dialectique}}           |                                                     |
| a synthesis of documents (DALF)        | {{une synthèse de documents}}     |                                                     |
| an oral presentation (in class)        | {{un exposé}}                     |                                                     |
| to draw conclusions                    | {{tirer des conclusions}}         |                                                     |
| I maintain that                        | {{Je soutiens que}}               | `soutenir une thèse` = to defend a thesis           |
